bugs.title: Required B-fe8f regression cannot read the immutable historical probe rp-mtifubae-dfbh4w in a real worktree

evidence.symptom: Mandatory red-bfe8f-ledger-runtime-integrity.mjs failed because it required historical clone-local candidate cache bytes not present in this real worktree.
reproSteps: Before integration, run node packages/main/tests/red/red-bfe8f-ledger-runtime-integrity.mjs: artifact ref not found for rp-mtifubae-dfbh4w.
Merge independently completed main 874e081862 at 5f2eab09fb, build current main package, rerun the same command.
evidence.rootCause: The regression guard conflated portable checks of committed historical RED references and actual baseline/current execution with availability of old clone-local candidate CAS. Upstream 9b8ca8879f separates historical reference/replay checks from actual current candidate API integrity checks in a private fixture.
evidence.fixEvidence: Exact post-merge command exited 0 with historicalBaselineFails=true currentGreenPasses=true currentCorruptedRelationRejected=true assertionUnchanged=true. Output explicitly declares historicalCandidateCAS=not-consumed liveCandidate=fixture-only restoredHistoricalCAS=false. This closes the mandatory-regression portability defect, not restoration of the historical CAS. Original probe content was independently located in its original reviewer transcript and its digest recomputed exactly; no historical object or timestamp was fabricated. Canonical full validation and other failures remain pending.

bugs.title: Mandatory heartbeat foreign-append fixture times out after an unsupported 5-second CLI startup wait, hides early child diagnostics and can remove its directory before child completion; isolated F010 passes but delayed-marker counterexample reproduces the readiness defect.

evidence.symptom: The required heartbeat suite intermittently timed out waiting for command-started.txt; an isolated foreign-append run could pass.
reproSteps: Build test-only RED 9e3ac2e5ef, then run node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke.js --readiness-only.
The unchanged readiness path exits 1 after five seconds although the real six-second delayed child completes normally.
Inspect original readiness and runCli: early output was not observed, and the watchdog result could settle before close.
evidence.rootCause: The test imposed an unsupported five-second CLI startup assumption and conflated a settled harness result with child closure. This is a fixture defect, not evidence of a production timeout defect.
evidence.fixEvidence: GREEN 5662e8274e supplies bounded terminal-aware startup, a release handshake, actual-close draining, retention on missing closure/null status, and real-child plus synthetic negative controls. After the final successful build, the entire validate-progress-heartbeat-smoke command exited 0 and printed validate-progress-heartbeat smoke passed, including the unchanged foreign-append safety assertions. Audit 0fc834f56d records the limits. Canonical repository-wide validation, independent host assurance and lifecycle completion remain separate requirements.
